title: Design System: Claude Code CLI, on one page

display.purpose: The H1 inside the welcome box, led by a terracotta ✻ at weight 400.

headline.purpose: Section H2s with a hover-revealed # anchor.

subtitle.purpose: H3/H4 sub-headings, always prefixed with ## in Ink 3.

body.purpose: Prose; ledes and descriptions capped at 68ch.

code.purpose: Command rows and command cells, ligatures off; file contents at 0.8125rem.

label.purpose: Labels above commands and demos, table headers (700), hints; Ink 3, sentence case.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for colour, border and reveal transitions.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover/state colour and border transitions on controls.

motion.name: status
motion.purpose: Mode status line and sidebar current-item changes.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Section fade-up on first intersection; only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference, content visible by default.

motion.name: cursor-blink
motion.purpose: Block cursor in the slash input; steady when motion is reduced.

components.name: Shell Command Row
components.description: Every copyable shell command: $ glyph in Ink 3, visible copy button.
components.html: $curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash
components.css: .ds-cmd { display: flex; align-items: stretch; background: var(--surface, #221f1c); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #3b3631); border-radius: 6px; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--ink, #ede8e1); } .ds-cmd-body { display: flex; gap: 0.75ch; flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 0.625rem 0.25rem 0.625rem 0.875rem; overflow-x: auto; } .ds-cmd-body code { white-space: pre; font-family: inherit; font-variant-ligatures: none; } .ds-glyph { color: var(--ink-3, #9a9187); user-select: none; } .ds-copy { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; min-width: 2.75rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule, #3b3631); background: transparent; color: var(--ink-3, #9a9187); font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace); font-size: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-copy:hover { color: var(--ink, #ede8e1); background: var(--raised, #2b2723); } .ds-copy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #d97757); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The page is rendered in Claude Code’s own interface language rather than a generic developer-tool template. Its parts are the TUI’s parts: the rounded welcome box, the `>` input prompt, the status line that cycles permission modes, the slash menu, the `⏺` response bullet, markdown headings that keep their `## `. A reader should know within a second that this is Claude Code, and every device on the page should be something Claude Code itself draws.

The ground is a warm charcoal, the ink a warm off-white, and a single Claude-terracotta accent marks what is active or actionable. Structure comes from 1px rules and rounded box-drawing borders, never from cards, shadows, glows or gradients. Density is that of a reference sheet: ruled tables, stacked command rows, prose held to a readable measure. Motion is limited to a one-time fade-up on reveal, a blinking block cursor, and short colour transitions.

The world refuses the centred neon hero, fake macOS windows with traffic lights, and the card grid as structure.
keyCharacteristics: Warm charcoal ground, warm off-white ink, one terracotta accent.
JetBrains Mono for anything typed or rendered by the TUI; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for prose.
The prompt glyph carries meaning: `$` is a system shell, `>` is the Claude Code REPL.
Rounded boxes (10px) echo Claude Code’s input and output boxes; plain command rows and files use 6px.
Flat: depth comes from three tonal steps and rules, not shadows.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Terracotta appears only on the uses listed under Primary. Anything else that wants emphasis gets weight or Ink, not the accent.

rules.name: The Product-Truth Hue Rule
rules.body: Violet and teal exist because Claude Code’s status line uses them. They never decorate anything outside the mode status line.

rules.name: The Typed-Versus-Read Rule
rules.body: If the TUI would render it or a user would type it (headings, commands, paths, slash names, status line), it is mono. Labels, table headers, bylines, descriptions and callout titles are Atkinson.

rules.name: The No-Ligature Rule
rules.body: Code turns ligatures off so every command copies and reads exactly as typed.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, glow or gradient fill. Hover and selection are expressed through colour, the accent wash, or a border shift.

dos: **Do** draw new surfaces from Claude Code’s own vocabulary: rounded boxes, prompt glyphs, the status line, the slash menu, `⏺` responses, `## ` headings.
**Do** mark every shell command with `$` and every REPL input with a terracotta `>`, and give every command and file a visible copy button with a 44px target.
**Do** keep terracotta to the listed uses (welcome border, `✻` marks, prompt glyphs, `⏺` bullets, active mode, current nav, hover, focus, download).
**Do** keep every text colour at 4.5:1 or better on ground, surface and raised.
**Do** let long commands scroll inside their row with the edge fade rather than wrapping or widening the page.
**Do** keep motion optional: content visible by default, reveal and cursor blink only under `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`.
donts: **Don't** add shadows, glows or gradient fills; depth is tone and rules.
**Don't** draw macOS window chrome or traffic lights around code; files are named by filename only.
**Don't** use cards as structure or lay content out as a card grid; use ruled rows, tables and boxes.
**Don't** use violet or teal outside the mode status line.
**Don't** introduce a light theme or a second accent.
**Don't** set prose in mono or headings in the sans.
